title: @DiceMetric
description: Computes Dice Metric between BASE and each of the DSET volumes

dsets.description: Data sets for which the Dice Metric with BASE is computed. This should be the last option on the command line.
dsets.title: Dataset Segmentation

max_roi.description: The maximum possible ROI index. Default is 12 or based on LTFILE if specified.
max_roi.title: Maximum ROI Index

labeltable.description: If given, the labeltable is used to set the default MAX_ROI parameter. Also, this option forces an output for each key in the LTFILE.
labeltable.title: Label Table File

forceoutput.description: If given, force output for each class in LTFILE.
forceoutput.title: Force Output File

do_not_mask_by_base.description: Do not mask dset by step(base) before computing Dice coefficient.
do_not_mask_by_base.title: Do Not Mask by Base

mask_by_base.description: Mask dset by the step(base) before computing Dice coefficient.
mask_by_base.title: Mask by Base

prefix.description: Use PREFIX for the output table. Default is separate results for each dset to stdout.
prefix.title: Output Prefix

ignore_bad.description: Warn if encountering bad scenarios, but do not create a zero entry.
ignore_bad.title: Ignore Bad Scenarios

keep_tmp.description: Keep temporary files for debugging. Note that you should delete temporary files before rerunning the script.
keep_tmp.title: Keep Temporary Files
